name: Francisco Cerúndolo
intro: Francisco Cerúndolo is from Buenos Aires, Argentina. Everyone calls him Fran. He is famous for a huge, whip-crack forehand.
story: Fran started tennis at age 5. His mom and dad both played tennis. They run a tennis school in Buenos Aires. His little brother Juan Manuel is a pro too. This summer Fran won his biggest title ever, on grass in London.

funFacts.text: His secret talent is math. He loves numbers and checking stats.
His favorite foods are burgers and asado, Argentine barbecue.
He loves to sing. He packs a speaker to play music in every hotel room.
His sister María Constanza won field hockey gold at the Youth Olympics.
He and his brother Juan Manuel were in the world top 100 at the same time.
His favorite movie is Gladiator. He cheers for the River Plate soccer club.
He once lost his passport on a trip and missed his plane.

watchFor: Watch him run around his backhand to smack a giant forehand.
